explanation: Server-rendered content is visible and passes any assertion on what the page shows well before it responds to anything; until hydration a click opens no dialog. How long that takes varies with machine load, so no fixed wait is right.
fix: The root layout sets `data-hydrated` on `<html>` in `onMount`; `cy.visit`/`cy.reload` are overwritten to wait for it and the fixed waits are removed.
